title: Savings, Investment and Interest
introduction: Explore savings, investment and interest using everyday examples.
definition: Savings preserve money for later use. Investments aim for returns but can lose value. Simple interest is based on original principal; compound interest adds interest to the balance before the next interest period. Use hypothetical rates for calculations.

examples.question: RM100 earns 10% simple interest each year for two years.
steps: RM10 each year; total interest RM20.

exercises.question: RM200 saved at 5% simple annual interest for one year. Interest RM?
RM100 at 10% compounded annually for two years. Balance RM?
RM100 investment falls to RM80. Loss RM?
RM50 saved each month for 6 months. Total?
RM400 investment gives RM20 dividend. Return amount RM?

summary: Savings preserve money for later use. Investments aim for returns but can lose value. Simple interest is based on original principal; compound interest adds interest to the balance before the next interest period. Use hypothetical rates for calculations.
